Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy for Gemini Copilot

Effective Date: November 2026

1. Overview

Gemini Copilot for PowerPoint ("the Add-in") is designed with a strict zero-data-retention, client-side-only privacy architecture. We do not operate external proxy servers, databases, or logging mechanisms for your presentation content or API keys.

2. API Key Storage & Handling

  • Your Google AI Studio API Key is stored exclusively on your device inside your browser or Office WebView2 localStorage.
  • Your API key is never transmitted to us or any third-party server other than directly to Google's official Generative Language API endpoint (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com).

3. Presentation Content & Data Transmission

  • When you generate slides, rewrite text, or ask questions in Copilot Chat, only the prompt text and selected slide text are transmitted directly from your client to Google Gemini.
  • No presentation slides, files, notes, or prompts are stored, monitored, or logged by the developers of this add-in.
  • For details on how Google handles API requests under Google AI Studio, please refer to Google's Generative AI Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

4. Contact & Support

If you have questions regarding this privacy policy, please contact support via the add-in support channel.
